newsitem.title: USA: Complete Wellness to integrate clinics.
newsitem.headline: Complete Wellness to integrate clinics.

text.p: Complete Wellness Centers Inc said on Tuesday it signed management agreements to medically integrate 12 additional chiropractic clinics, bringing the total of such contracts to 77.

Complete Wellness Centers successfully completed its initial public offering of one million shares of common stock and one million warrants on February 19 1997, raising gross proceeds of $6.1 million. The company's stock and warrants trade on the NASDAQ Smallcap Market under the symbols CMWL and CMWLW respectively.

Complete Wellness Centers, a Washington DC-based developer of multi-disciplinary medical centers, manages the first chain of medical wellness centers with a national name brand. The company manages or has contracts to manage 77 wellness centers.
